commentary_segments.text: The layout is shown of a differential pair, each transistor of which consists of two equal transistors, connected in parallel but laid out in opposite corners. As a result, the effects of global changes, for example, in oxide thickness, are averaged out. For example, MOST 2b has the lowest K∞ but MOST 2a the highest one. Putting them in parallel gives an average value for K∞ which is about the same as for MOSTs 1a and 1b. Care must be take however, not to insert additional resistances in the Source connections, to connect the transistor terminals. Judicious use of the two or more layers of interconnect is thus mandatory.
